preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for word in ['Sand', 'Water', 'Fish', 'Sun'] for match in [re.search(re.escape(word), input_str, re.IGNORECASE)] if match and match.start() >= (max((m.start() + len(m.group())) for m in (re.search(re.escape(w), input_str, re.IGNORECASE) for w in ['Sand', 'Water', 'Fish', 'Sun']) if m) if any(re.search(re.escape(w), input_str, re.IGNORECASE) for w in ['Sand', 'Water', 'Fish', 'Sun']) else -1) or -1) for m in [re.search(re.escape(word), input_str, re.IGNORECASE)] if m])
postconditions.description: The output is the count of non-overlapping occurrences of the words 'Sand', 'Water', 'Fish', or 'Sun' in the input string, case-insensitive. Overlapping is determined by the start position of each match being greater than or equal to the end position of the previous match.
